cli.executable: npm global @anthropic-ai/claude-code shim on the Windows host, invoked from WSL (Ubuntu)

auth: Claude subscription login (apiKeySource: none); no credentials recorded
argv_notes: default-start omits --thinking-display; stdin carries one stream-json user line identical to protocol.rs user_message_line
sanitization: signatures, signature_delta and input_json_delta payloads emptied; session ids, uuids, msg_/toolu_/req_ ids replaced by stable placeholders; local paths rewritten; environment inventories and hook output emptied. Field presence and frame order retained.
transport_findings: thinking_delta fragments carry public summary prose when summarized is requested, interleaved with system/thinking_tokens frames
without the flag the same blocks stream empty thinking text plus estimated_tokens
each content block is followed by one buffered assistant frame (same message id as message_start) carrying only that block, emitted immediately before its content_block_stop
the buffered thinking text equals the concatenated streamed fragments in every captured block
summary prose arrives in paragraph bursts: the first paragraph lands while the stretch is still running

research_provenance.desktop_app: Claude desktop 1.40609.1 (MSIX Claude_2.9939.2.0_x64__pzs8sxrjxfjjc), embedded Claude Code 2.1.255

files.description: Tool cycle: Read, one thinking stretch beside a second Read, answer text.
Two Reads, then one message with a two-paragraph thinking block and answer text.
Fresh start in summarized mode; adaptive thinking chose not to think (no-thinking turn).
Native --resume of the same session; one thinking block plus answer text.
No --thinking-display flag: thinking block with empty text and estimates only.
Process group killed after the first text delta: no result frame.
Constructed from the real transport shape: two thinking stretches around a tool_use in one message (block indexes 0 and 2), markdown in the second summary.
Real resume capture truncated after the third thinking delta: EOF mid-stretch.
